skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Author a new Agent Skill from a minimal SKILL.md template.

skills.name: maintainer
skills.description: Guidance for maintaining the Inference Gateway ecosystem (main Go gateway, CLI, operator, SDKs, docs, schemas, ADL, low-code, registry, etc.). Use when working inside any repo in that GitHub org (locally or in a CI checkout), when changes ripple across repos (e.g., OpenAPI/schema changes that affect SDKs and docs), or when filing GitHub issues against ecosystem repos.

skills.name: adl
skills.description: Author and maintain projects built with ADL (Agent Definition Language) - the YAML manifest format from inference-gateway/adl that adl-cli turns into a full A2A agent scaffold (Go/Rust/TypeScript). Use when working inside a generated agent project (presence of agent.yaml + .adl-ignore), when editing the manifest, when implementing custom tools and skills against the generated scaffold, or when planning the schema-first / domain modelling for a new agent.
